model: Hugging Face RT-DETRv2 (PekingU/rtdetr_v2_r18vd, COCO-pretrained, 1-class head) on 256-px crops upscaled 2x; tiled full-image inference
labels_from: one box per 8-connected component of label==1 (the peak mask), bounding box padded by 3 px per side (boxes ~7-16 px); no box labels exist in the dataset

train.selected: it 400 by val AP50 (0.584 on 120 val images, score thr 0.10 picked there); training stopped at it ~1400 because val AP50 collapsed (0.073 @800, 0.016 @1200)

notes: AP50 is COCO-style (101-point interpolated precision envelope, greedy matching by score at IoU>=0.5, single class), computed in seg/detection.py over the whole test split; precision/recall/F1 at the val-picked score threshold 0.10. Inference: 256-px tiles with 32-px overlap, each upscaled 2x, keep detections whose centre lies in the tile core, then NMS IoU 0.3. Saturated (>=60000) pixels are set to background in the input. Many false positives are correct peaks whose predicted box is smaller than the padded label box (IoU < 0.5), so AP50 understates peak finding. det_a was unstable after warmup (lr 1e-4); a retry det_b (lr 2e-5, EMA 0.999, frozen BN) runs in round 2.
